data.name: The City Of Akhetaten
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Shape your own destiny and conquer a world beyond the elements!

The City Of Akhetaten delivers an adrenaline-fueled experience where high-stakes top-down combat meets the ultimate creative freedom of sandbox base-building. In these unforgiving lands, a sharp blade won't be enough to survive. You must make tactical decisions, fortify your sanctuary, and step through mysterious portals to unravel the secrets of a changing world.

⚔️ Choose Your Path & Master Your Skills

Don't just be another warrior. Embark on your journey by selecting a class that perfectly fits your tactical playstyle:

  • Offense: A high-damage, frontline bruiser built to crush enemy lines.

  • Support: A defensive powerhouse focused on survival, utility, and shielding allies.

  • Marksman: A swift, agile ranged combatant who rains down death from the shadows. As you level up, dive into a detailed, branching Skill Tree to customize your active spells and passive buffs to create the ultimate build.

🔨 Gather, Craft, and Reshape the World

The world is your canvas and your laboratory. Chop down sturdy oak trees, mine precious veins, and harvest wheat fields. Use the advanced, free-form building mode to design your fortress or village from scratch—placing walls, roofs, windows, and defensive structures. Set up crafting benches to forge tier-based gear, upgrading your equipment from basic copper to legendary golden swords and armor.

🗺️ Portals and Uncharted Realms

Journey through arid desert outposts and past the shadows of ancient pyramids to activate mystical portals. These gateways transport you to entirely different ecosystems—like lush, dense, yet deadly forests teeming with region-specific resources and unique threats. Don't trek across these vast lands on foot; summon your loyal mount to traverse the open world with speed.

🏹 Fluid Hack & Slash Combat & Looting

Desert bandits, goblin encampments, and ancient anomalies—every corner of the map is crawling with hostile forces waiting to ambush you. Engage in responsive, combo-driven top-down combat. Vanquish hordes of enemies to gain XP, level up, and harvest rare loot like leather scraps and precious ores to constantly upgrade your build.

💰 A Living Sandbox Economy

Discover secure desert oases and trading hubs to interact with local merchants. Sell your excess materials gathered from dangerous expeditions to accumulate gold, or spend your fortune on rare crafting ingredients, powerful gear blueprints, and vital supplies to accelerate your progression.

KEY FEATURES

  • Versatile Class System: Dynamically mold your character to fit your exact combat preferences.

  • Modular Base Building: Enjoy total creative freedom with a free-form building system to protect your loot.

  • Portal Exploration: Travel between drastically different biomes in search of rare, high-tier resources.

  • Deep Crafting Progression: Forge and upgrade your weapons and armor through various material tiers (Copper, Iron, Gold).

  • Mount System: Summon customizable mounts to explore a vast, beautiful open world efficiently.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
